# Test-driven development — red-green-refactor, AAA pattern and test doubles

Curated by Skill Harbor — @bobmatnyc's TDD skill: a rigorous test-driven development methodology, not just "write tests". Enforces the red-green-refactor cycle — write the failing test first, make the minimal change to pass, refactor mercilessly — with the AAA pattern (Arrange, Act, Assert), FIRST principles (Fast, Independent, Repeatable, Self-validating, Timely), a full taxonomy of test doubles (dummies, stubs, fakes, spies, mocks and when each applies), test-naming conventions, coverage philosophy, and anti-patterns to avoid. Honest caveats: two older TDD fiches already exist in the catalog (obra-tdd and addyosmani-test-driven-development) — this one is kept for its strict methodology and test-doubles depth; check whether the existing ones fit before installing a third. MIT licensed (manifest record authoritative; the skill file's own Apache-2.0 mention is superseded by the manifest). Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
